title: Torches for the Dark
offer: The nights grow long. The guests of the autumn feast need light: bring me tar for torches, two pots from Ekvik, and two crates of flax for the wicks.

steps.load_say: Tar for torches? They burn bright and long.

steps.say: Tar and flax: now my torches will light up the whole bay!

fact: Viking torches were sticks wrapped in flax or cloth, soaked in tar or fat.
